relations.myth: Primordial paired powers invoked for Unas
relations.note: Amaunet and Amun appear together as an early paired divine unit.

relations.myth: Creation by the Ogdoad
relations.note: Mature Ogdoad theology makes Amaunet the female partner of Amun.
Some Karnak ritual genealogies reportedly describe Amaunet as Amun's daughter.
Some Karnak texts reportedly present Amaunet as Amun's sister-wife.
Alternate Karnak genealogies reportedly present Amaunet as Amun's sister-wife.

relations.note: Late theology calls Amaunet mother of Ra, light, or the solar child.

relations.note: Amaunet is associated with the primordial lotus or cow producing Ra.
Amaunet receives Neith-like titles, iconography, and the compound Neith-Amaunet.

relations.myth: Self-generation of the ithyphallic creator
relations.note: Amaunet acts as consort of Amun-Min in Theban creator theology.

relations.myth: Self-generation of the ithyphallic creator
relations.note: Amaunet paradoxically mothers the creator who is also her consort.

relations.myth: Ogdoad attends the locally emerging Hathor
relations.note: Amaunet's Ogdoadic group worships or attends Hathor at Dendera.
Mut became Amun's dominant consort while Amaunet remained active at Karnak.

relations.myth: Stargate Goa'uld storyline
relations.note: The fictional Goa'uld Amaunet is Apophis's mate, without ancient precedent.

relations.myth: Stargate Goa'uld storyline
relations.note: The fictional Amaunet bears the Harsesis child.

relations.myth: Stargate Goa'uld storyline
